about.title: About this platform
about.missionBody: We make trustworthy health education accessible to everyone — including Afaan Oromoo speakers — by combining structured, easy-to-understand disease information with an AI assistant that answers your questions in your language.
about.disclaimerBody: All content on this platform is general health education. It is not a diagnosis, not medical advice, and does not replace a consultation with a qualified health professional. If you are unwell, please see a doctor.
about.teamBody: A small team of developers, health writers, and Afaan Oromoo speakers building a free, open, and bilingual health reference.
about.contactBody: For questions, corrections, or feedback, please reach out through the project repository.
